title: MLC (metal-ligand-compliance) ablation
description: Effect of the metal-ligand-compliance (MLC) probe on Lambda MCTS output cohort. With MLC active + metal-seed, the cohort collapses to the seed SMILES itself (n_distinct=1, trivially compliant). Without MLC, the diversity lift (n_distinct=20) breaks compliance because Pt-acetylide roots are not strict-Pt_II compliant (EXPECTED_TRADE_OFF, not regression).

series.name: metal_compliance_rate
series.note: MLC is mechanically driven by seed selection. 1.0 trivially on cisplatin seed; 0.0 mechanically without seed; 0.0 with diversity lift (Pt-acetylide [Pt]C#C root ≠ Pt_II coord=4).

series.name: n_distinct (metal-ligand pairs)
series.note: 1 pre-fix (singleton collapse); 20 post-fix (Path A 4-fix bundle lifts diversity).

summary.open_question: Can we recover compliance WITH diversity? Requires F2(a) MetalLigandExchange SMARTS rule (TODO-29) — structural fix needed, deferred to R17 follow-up.
summary.verdict: EXPECTED_TRADE_OFF — metal_compliance 1.0 → 0.0 is the cost of lifting n_distinct 1 → 20. Honest metric design; not a regression. Open: Pt_II-strict click-compatible Pt root.
summary.singleton_collapse_warning: Round-12 10×3 results: all 30 cells collapse to [NH2][Pt]([NH2])([Cl])[Cl] (n_distinct=1) when --metal-seed cisplatin + --click-rules all-5; metal_compliance=1.0 is HONEST but TRIVIAL.
